cards.f: Reading: how many marks and groups?

cards.b: Longer texts with short answers in German (12 and 11 marks).
Matching tasks: pictures, signs, people to places.
Write only the information asked for; use words from the text; give both parts if two details are asked.
negatives: check they don't reverse the meaning.
Skim = general idea; scan = find a specific detail.

gaps.s: Wie lange dauert der Film? ___ lange asks about duration. (question word)
« Er kommt aus Spanien. » Question: ___ kommt er? (where from)
Ein Wort, das wie ein englisches klingt und dasselbe bedeutet, ist ein ___ .
Ein falscher Freund: « der Chef » bedeutet auf Englisch ___ .

short.q: Why should you read the questions before the text?
short.model: You know what information to look for, so you read faster and find answers more accurately.

short.q: Elif plays volleyball on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Write the short answer to: Wann hat sie Training?
How do you decide between three MCQ options?
short.model: Find the sentence in the text, eliminate options that say the opposite or are not mentioned, watch for negatives.

short.q: What can you do with an unknown compound noun?
short.model: Split it into parts and translate each: Hausaufgaben = Haus + Aufgaben.

short.q: Give two things to avoid in short-answer questions.
short.model: Copying too much text with a wrong detail; leaving it blank; mixing a correct and a wrong answer.
